name: Coarray Remote Memory Access (CAF)
description: Coarray indexing a[image_id] lowers to _caf_get/_caf_put OpenCoarrays runtime calls; SYNC ALL becomes a barrier
source:
subroutine coarray_halo_exchange(a, n)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  real, intent(inout) :: a(n)[*]

  integer :: me, nimg
  me   = THIS_IMAGE()
  nimg = NUM_IMAGES()

  if (me > 1) then
    a(1) = a(n)[me - 1]
  end if

  SYNC ALL
end subroutine coarray_halo_exchange

    Array subscript: n   → local element index (1-based)
    Image subscript: me-1 → remote image index
    Access type: REMOTE READ (get)
    Runtime call: _caf_get(token, image_idx, src_offset, dst_ptr, elem_size, num_elements)
    Token: compile-time coarray registration handle

llvm_ir.content:
; ModuleID = '07_coarray.f90'
; OpenCoarrays ABI declarations
declare i32 @_caf_this_image()
declare i32 @_caf_num_images()
declare void @_caf_get(ptr, i32, i64, ptr, i64, i64)
declare void @_caf_sync_all()

; Coarray token — global opaque registration handle
@_QFcoarray_halo_exchangeEa.token = global ptr null

define void @_QPcoarray_halo_exchange(
    ptr nocapture %0,           ; a(:)[*]
    ptr nocapture readonly %1   ; n
) #0 !dbg !5 {
entry:
  ; THIS_IMAGE(), NUM_IMAGES() — runtime calls, not compile-time constants
  %me   = call i32 @_caf_this_image(), !dbg !10
  %nimg = call i32 @_caf_num_images(), !dbg !10

  %n_val = load i32, ptr %1, align 4, !dbg !10
  %n_ext = sext i32 %n_val to i64

  %c1    = i32 1
  %cond  = icmp sgt i32 %me, 1, !dbg !11
  br i1 %cond, label %if_body, label %sync_block, !dbg !11

if_body:
  ; Compute source image index: me - 1
  %src_img = sub i32 %me, 1, !dbg !12

  ; Byte offset for a(n): (n-1) * 4 bytes
  %n_m1    = sub nsw i64 %n_ext, 1, !dbg !12
  %offset  = mul nsw i64 %n_m1, 4, !dbg !12   ; sizeof(float) = 4

  ; Destination pointer: a(1) = base + offset 0
  %dst_ptr = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr %0, i64 0, !dbg !12

  ; Load coarray token (registered at startup by OpenCoarrays)
  %token   = load ptr, ptr @_QFcoarray_halo_exchangeEa.token, align 8, !dbg !12

  ; Remote get: copies element from image (me-1) into local a(1)
  ; ABI: _caf_get(token, src_image, src_offset_bytes, dst_ptr, elem_bytes, n_elems)
  call void @_caf_get(ptr %token, i32 %src_img, i64 %offset,
                      ptr %dst_ptr, i64 4, i64 1), !dbg !12
  br label %sync_block

sync_block:
  ; SYNC ALL — global barrier across all images
  call void @_caf_sync_all(), !dbg !13
  ret void, !dbg !14
}

; KEY INSIGHT: There is NO load/store for the remote element.
; All remote memory access goes through the OpenCoarrays ABI.
; The token is a compile-time opaque handle registered at program startup.

correlations.lowering_notes: Coarray remote element access a(n)[me-1] generates a single _caf_get call — there is no LLVM load/store for the remote element. The compiler encodes three pieces of information: (1) the coarray token (compile-time registration), (2) the source image index (me-1 computed at runtime), (3) the byte offset of element a(n) computed as (n-1)*sizeof(f32). The OpenCoarrays runtime handles the inter-process communication, which may be MPI point-to-point, shared memory, or RDMA depending on build configuration.

SYNC ALL maps to a single runtime call that serves as a global barrier across all coarray images. No IR around it — no registers saved, no memory ops — just a call site. The barrier's semantics are entirely in the runtime library.
